answer.reason: Several verses tell events that happened at the river: Israel's crossing, Naaman's cleansing and the baptism of Jesus.

clauses.english: had its waters cut off so that Israel crossed on dry ground
clauses.quote: all the Israelites passed over on dry ground

clauses.english: was where Naaman dipped seven times and was made clean
clauses.quote: dipped himself seven times in Jordan

clauses.english: was where Jesus was baptized by John
clauses.quote: was baptized of John in Jordan

doubts: Elijah's and Elisha's parting of the waters (2KI 2) was left out to keep the line short.
Many marked verses use Jordan only as a boundary or a direction ("beyond Jordan"), so they were not used.
